notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Allies.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Harabaz Druid and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Harabaz Druid's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
